title: Jacobi algorithm
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, encode its first decoded component together with the encoding of its second decoded component paired with $[\mathrm{false}]$. Apply the step function $2(|z|+1)$ times to this encoding, where $|z|$ is the length of $z$, and then apply the output function.
caveat: The encoding, decoding, step, and output operations are not defined in the supplied payload, so the algorithm's mathematical inputs and output cannot be identified more specifically.
